page_title: NAP 2-2 ROM | Napoli v AS Roma 15/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: El Shaarawy S. Achilles Tendon Injury

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.

90+4' That was a nice football moment. Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom left corner. Mile Svilar guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
90+4' Robinio Vaz (AS Roma) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
90+2' Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) was too forceful with his tackle and Andrea Colombo interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Giovane (Napoli) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
89' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Napoli win a corner kick.
88' Robinio Vaz (AS Roma) does well to reach the lofted pass in the centre of the box, but doesn't make full contact and his header drifts well past the right post.
87' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) commits a foul during an attacking move.
86' Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Vanja Milinkovic-Savic.
84' Substitution. Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) on for Matteo Politano.
82' Lorenzo Venturino (AS Roma) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
82' 2 - 2 Brilliant finish! Alisson Santos (Napoli) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Giovane, then produced a nice strike into the bottom left corner. The score is 2:2.
79' Antonio Conte decides to make a substitution. Antonio Vergara will be replaced by Giovane (Napoli).
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Billy Gilmour (Napoli) is coming onto the pitch as Eljif Elmas cannot continue after picking up an injury.
77' The linesman signals that Robinio Vaz (AS Roma) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

76' Great solo effort by Alisson Santos (Napoli) as he tricks his way through two defenders before firing a drive from just outside of the box towards the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper is ready and produces a stunning save.
72' Here is a change. Donyell Malen is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Robinio Vaz (AS Roma).
72' That's the end of the game for Wesley Franca, who is replaced by Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma).
71' 1 - 2 Goal! Donyell Malen (AS Roma) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Vanja Milinkovic-Savic into right side of the goal.
71' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
71' Alisson Santos (Napoli) comes onto the pitch because Amir Rrahmani simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
70' Antonio Conte has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mathias Olivera (Napoli) replacing Leonardo Spinazzola.
70' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
70' Looks like Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
69' Caution goes to Amir Rrahmani (Napoli).
68' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Amir Rrahmani (Napoli). Andrea Colombo saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. PENALTY to AS Roma! Great chance to score.
67' Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

66' Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Mile Svilar. This effort really didn't trouble him.
65' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to substitute Lorenzo Pellegrini and he is replaced by Lorenzo Venturino (AS Roma).
65' Niccolo Pisilli comes off the pitch to be replaced by Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma).
64' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
64' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared. The ball is out of play and AS Roma manage to earn a corner.
63' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) commits a rough foul. Andrea Colombo stops the game and makes a call. AS Roma win a free kick.
62' Antonio Vergara (Napoli) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
60' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
59' Matteo Politano (Napoli) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Andrea Colombo blows his whistle for an infringement.
58' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
52' The Napoli players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
49' It looks like Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) saw red with that tackle. Andrea Colombo won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
47' The ball is crossed into the box and Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the right side of the goal, but Mile Svilar gets a glove on it to thwart him.
46' Half-time substitution. Bryan Zaragoza is replaced by Matias Soule (AS Roma).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+2' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post.
45+1' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. AS Roma have a free kick.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' AS Roma are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
40' 1 - 1 Goal! Eljif Elmas passes the ball to Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Mile Svilar couldn't do anything about it. 1:1.
37' Sam Beukema (Napoli) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
36' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender.
34' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle as Donyell Malen (AS Roma) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
31' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the left post by a whisker.

29' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
29' Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to AS Roma.
28' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Andrea Colombo has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
26' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) receives a yellow card for infringement.
24' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
23' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
22' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) tackles a bit over-zealously and Andrea Colombo blows for a foul.
19' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the left post.
16' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Mile Svilar.
15' The corner from Eljif Elmas (Napoli) is intercepted by Mile Svilar.

15' Antonio Vergara (Napoli) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. The referee blows his whistle, Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
12' Napoli keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
10' Andrea Colombo blows for a foul after Wesley Franca (AS Roma) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
7' 0 - 1 Goal! A great through ball by Bryan Zaragoza sets up Donyell Malen (AS Roma) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the roof of the net. 0:1.
3' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
3' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) trips an opposition player and Andrea Colombo signals a foul. Free kick. AS Roma will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and AS Roma will have the kick-off.
Andrea Colombo got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
